_comment: Starter universal, medium-agnostic voice rules. This is the base rule set every project can rely on; a project adds its own preferences on top via voice-gate.py --local-rules PATH (see config.example/voice-rules.local.json). Reclassify a token by moving it between hard_fail and advisory. Keep the base set short and genuinely universal — the AI-tell words and em-dash rule below are widely recognized model tells, not one author's stylistic taste.

chars.note: No em-dashes in prose (recognized AI tell); use a comma or parenthetical, or restructure. Headings and pure divider lines are exempt (structural, not prose).

regex.note: En-dash used as em-dash in prose. Numeric ranges like 3–5 are allowed; headings and divider lines are exempt.

phrases.note: time-contingent phrasing; run a currency check before publishing (see docs/AUTHORING-STRATEGY.md)
